600 eV / Γ only for the slab

assumptions: Coordinates are generated geometric starting guesses, not the authors' optimized structures.
The orthogonal surface axes are [110], [-110] and [001], crystallographically equivalent to a (100)-family slab. Dimers run along the model y direction.
Six primitive-cell thickness units are represented by twelve carbon atomic planes. Each plane contains nx×ny sites, giving 240 heavy-atom sites for the default model.

Surface atoms on both faces are paired into flat, unbuckled dimers. The absolute C–C dimer distance 1.54 Å and C–H distance 1.09 Å are user-adjustable construction assumptions, not values extracted from this paper.
The selected C–N dimer is shortened by the reported 5.5% relative to the assumed C–C distance; this is an initial guess, not an optimized C–N bond length.
Hydrogen directions are constructed opposite the sum of normalized neighboring C/N bond vectors. One top-surface H is removed at the N substitution site.
The 10 Å vacuum is implemented as the total periodic gap between the outermost atoms, with half of that gap on each side of the slab.
No methyl adsorbate, state-4/state-5/state-6 coordinates, transition state or electronic energy is inferred from figures. These remain missing inputs.
